command:
set -u
test_user=pwpolicy_probe
if id "$test_user" >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo userdel -r "$test_user" >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo userdel "$test_user"; fi
sudo useradd -m "$test_user"
cleanup() { sudo userdel -r "$test_user" >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo userdel "$test_user" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
randpart() { tr -dc "$1" </dev/urandom | head -c "$2"; }
short_pass="$(randpart 'A-Z' 3)$(randpart 'a-z' 3)$(randpart '0-9' 3)$(randpart '!@#$%^&*' 2)"
two_class_pass="$(randpart 'a-z' 8)$(randpart '0-9' 4)"
valid_pass="$(randpart 'A-Z' 6)$(randpart 'a-z' 6)$(randpart '0-9' 6)$(randpart '!@#$%^&*' 6)"
run_password_test() {
  label=$1
  candidate=$2
  out=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$candidate" "$candidate" | sudo passwd "$test_user" 2>&1)
  rc=$?
  printf '%s_RC=%s\n' "$label" "$rc"
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n '/BAD PASSWORD/p; /password updated successfully/p; /password unchanged/p; /Authentication token manipulation error/p'
  return "$rc"
}
run_password_test LENGTH_11 "$short_pass"; short_rc=$?
run_password_test LENGTH_12_TWO_CLASSES "$two_class_pass"; class_rc=$?
run_password_test VALID_24_FOUR_CLASSES "$valid_pass"; valid_rc=$?
printf 'ACCOUNT_STATUS='; sudo passwd -S "$test_user" | awk '{print $2}'
if [ "$short_rc" -eq 0 ] || [ "$class_rc" -eq 0 ] || [ "$valid_rc" -ne 0 ]; then
  printf 'POLICY_TEST=FAIL\n'
  exit 1
fi
printf 'POLICY_TEST=PASS\n'
